title: Pathing Plus
description: Plan your route before you commit. Pin map nodes to compare the routes through them, see a table of what each route offers (elites, fires, chests...), and zoom out to view the whole map at once. Works with mouse or controller. Informational only.
changeNote: v0.8.0 - Route trails are drawn heavier so they stand out from the map's own dashes, and the all-routes view at act start is much more readable. New: double-click a node to pin every node of that kind at once (all elites, all fires...); double-click again to clear them.
